messages:
Sam K: quick heads up — I'm on-call primary starting in ~30m but need to step out for ~2hrs for a personal errand. I can stay reachable for P1s but prefer someone take primary for the first 2 hours. @Anita R @Marc D any chance to swap? :wave:
Anita R: I can take primary for the first 90m then hand back. happy to be primary now if you want to swap immediately. :thumbsup:
Marc D: I can cover secondary. leaving slack open.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled rotation shows Sam K as primary for this shift.
Sam K: thanks @Anita R. I'll post the handoff in 5m. leaving quick runbook notes here: check model pool, autoscaler, and KV/cache fills. known hot path = model-serving-prod -> /v1/generate.
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT (sev-2) — 5xx spike on svc:model-serving-prod (3m avg = 18% errors). Triggered at 1719009980. Link: https://ops.example/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-214
Ops Pager: @channel paging: high error rate, customer impact potential for streaming responses (some customers seeing aborted responses).
Anita R: seeing same in dashboards — 5xx mostly 504/502 timeouts from workers. QPS steady but queue latency spiking.
Lia P: I'm nearby, can jump on bridge if needed.
Sam K: Anita — if you take primary now, please own the bridge and triage. Marc you stay secondary and monitor metrics. Lia, appreciate bridge help if we escalate.
Anita R: taking primary. Opening bridge now. joining https://meet.example/bridge-1719009999
Anita R: quick checks: 
```
# check pod restarts and OOMs
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=model-serving -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/model-worker --since=5m | grep "ERROR" | tail -n 50
# check autoscaler
kubectl -n prod get hpa model-worker
```
Anita R: hpa looks OK, pods at 12/12. CPU stable but avg response latency increased, and I see a few workers logging "kv cache full, evicting" repeatedly — might be KV eviction thrash.
Marc D: could be prefix cache blowup. any recent config change?
Sam K: no config change from me. last deploy was yesterday AM.
incident-bot: Runbook suggestion: Follow "Inference 5xx spike" runbook -> https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx. Steps: 1) confirm error pattern, 2) roll forward to fallback model variant, 3) scale/evict cache, 4) notify customers.
Anita R: I'm on step 1. Error pattern: bursty 504s during long-stream requests (clients abort after Xs).
Anita R: performing controlled rollback to fallback variant for heavy users: switching routing policy for route /v1/generate -> model-variant: gptx-small-fallback for 10% traffic.
Marc D: noted. I'll watch latency and error mashups.
Anita R: routing change applied: config patch:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/serve
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "traffic_shift": [{"model":"gptx-small-fallback","pct":10}]
}
```
Anita R: monitoring...
oncall-bot: Rollout event: traffic shift to gptx-small-fallback 10% at 1719010060 by Anita R.
Anita R: immediate drop in 5xx from 18% -> 10% in 3m. good sign.
Lia P: I deployed a cache eviction job to clear prefix cache on 3 pods (one at a time) per runbook step 3. Job logs show evictions completed without restart.
Marc D: errors down to ~6% and latency slowly dropping. looks like eviction helped reduce OOM/queue pressure.
Sam K: great. Anita, please keep primary until I return. I can be in the loop but stepping out for a bit.
Anita R: will stay primary for the next 90m. I'll escalate if errors don't go below 2%. Lia, thx for eviction job.
Lia P: np. left the job command in the bridge chat:
```
kubectl -n prod run cache-evict --rm --restart=OnFailure --image=tools:latest --command -- /bin/sh -c "python /opt/evictor.py --target model-worker --grace 30"
```
Anita R: posting quick customer-impact blurb (for comms): "We observed elevated timeouts on streaming generation endpoints affecting a subset of customers. Engineers implemented traffic fallback to a smaller model variant and cleared worker caches; errors are declining. We will follow up if further action needed."
Marc D: thumbs for that message. once we hit <2% errors we can close the PAGER.
incident-bot: NOTE: If customer impact >10% of requests, escalate to SEV-1 communications. Current estimate: ~4% of total streaming requests affected.
Anita R: current metrics at 1719011500: error rate 3.2%, tail latency 95p down from 2.1s -> 1.3s, queued requests decreasing.
Sam K: thanks all. I'll still be pingable for P1s but handing primary to Anita until 1719018000 (approx). leaving this thread open for updates.
Anita R: will hand back once stable. tagging runbook entries used: inference-5xx v2, cache-evict-helper. Added notes to incident: applied 10% fallback, eviction job x3, monitored for 45m.
Marc D: secondary monitoring. if anything flares I'll jump to bridge.
Anita R: closing bridge at 1719012700 since metrics stable. leaving final note: customers saw transient aborted streams; mitigated by routing fallback + cache evictions. No deploys required.
Sam K: appreciated. leaving emoji :heart:, thanks team.
Ops Pager: Incident resolved -> reduced error rate below threshold at 1719012790. Incident ticket INC-2026-214 updated and linked to runbook steps.
Anita R: handing primary back to Sam K at 1719012800.
Sam K: back on primary. all good. will post a short postmortem later with timeline and actions.
